question_text: Explain why a client-server service may keep its shared calculation rules on a central server when clients use different devices.
adaptation_rationale: Retains central-processing benefit through networking-model roles; no unsupported claim that server execution automatically makes data secure or speed identical.
solution: The server applies one maintained set of rules to every request, so clients do not need separate installations of the full calculation logic. Updating the service can make results consistent across clients, but clients depend on server availability and network access.

marking_points.criterion: Explains consistent updates/results for varied clients.
Develops maintenance/device benefit or server/network dependence.
